subject: Re: Latency outage — service credit proposal & trial extension
messages:
From: Julia Park <julia@starlite.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Latency spike — production impact and ask for credits

Hi Ava,

On Tuesday (8/18) our production traffic against the redwood-hosted endpoint for "starlite-search" experienced a sustained latency spike between 09:40-11:05 PDT. Our telemetry shows 5xx rate ~1.8% and p95 latency from 120ms -> 1.2s. This caused search timeouts and impacted user signups.

Can you share incident details and confirm whether Redwood will provide service credits or trial extension for the evaluation account? We're in the middle of a POC and need to understand remediation and financial make-good to continue.

Thanks,
Julia Park
Head of Infrastructure
Starlite AI

Attachment: starlite_incident_log_0820.pdf (log excerpt)

-----
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia@starlite.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Latency spike — production impact and ask for credits

Hi Julia —

Thanks for the heads up and the logs; sorry for the impact. We're actively investigating the root cause (looks like a transient autoscaling regression in the us-west pool). I want to propose an immediate short-term make-good:
- 20% service credit for Aug 18 incident on your current monthly spend
- 30-day trial extension on your evaluation org so your engineering team gets more time to validate

I'll need to confirm approvals internally for the credit amount; I've looped in Marissa (revenue ops) and Sean (customer success) to speed review. Expect a formal proposal by end of day tomorrow.

Best,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ava_chen@redwood.com | (555) 555-0199

Hi Julia —

Per our investigation, the outage was caused by a temporary autoscaling policy misconfiguration in the us-west serving pool. We apologize for the disruption.

Formal make-good proposal:
- 20% service credit applied to your August invoice (applies to usage billed by Redwood)
- 30-day trial extension for the evaluation org tied to your account
- One follow-up tech deep-dive session with our infra team (30 minutes) to review mitigations

I've attached the short make-good terms for signature: redwood_makegood_terms.docx
Please let us know if legal needs any edits; we can expedite.

Best,
Ava
